vendorMapSplitImpactLabel: Vendor Map Split Worked; Two Large Map Engines Remain
productionDecision: Patch 17 successfully split the old vendor-map bucket into separate Mapbox and MapLibre chunks. This is structurally cleaner and build-safe, but both map engines remain large. The next decision should be strategic: keep both engines with route-only loading, consolidate to one map engine, or remove one from production.
interpretation: Patch 17 did not eliminate the map warning, but it exposed the true structure of the problem.
Before Patch 17, Mapbox and MapLibre were hidden together inside one large vendor-map chunk.
After Patch 17, Mapbox and MapLibre are separated into two independent chunks.
This proves the remaining issue is not just manualChunks grouping; SHS currently includes two heavy map engines.
The correct next move is not to raise chunkSizeWarningLimit. The correct next move is to decide whether SHS should keep both map engines or consolidate to one.

maplibre.role: Operational map/globe and AI compass visual map surfaces

decisionOptions.label: Keep both Mapbox and MapLibre
decisionOptions.performanceResult: Two large map chunks remain, but the app keeps current behavior.
decisionOptions.recommendedWhen: Use this if Mapbox is required for Unified Truth and MapLibre is required for other map/globe surfaces.
decisionOptions.nextAction: Move to browser route signoff and accept map chunks as intentional heavy route assets.

decisionOptions.label: Route-only load map engines
decisionOptions.performanceResult: Can reduce initial route pressure if map chunks are only loaded on map routes.
decisionOptions.recommendedWhen: Use this if both engines must stay, but only specific routes should trigger them.
decisionOptions.nextAction: Audit generated HTML/modulepreload behavior and route loading to confirm whether map chunks preload too early.

decisionOptions.label: Consolidate core Unified Truth map from Mapbox to MapLibre
decisionOptions.performanceResult: Potentially removes Mapbox from production bundle and eliminates the largest map chunk.
decisionOptions.recommendedWhen: Use this if MapLibre can fully replace Mapbox features and design quality in Unified Truth.
decisionOptions.nextAction: Create a separate future refactor plan, not a quick bundle patch.

decisionOptions.label: Remove MapLibre surfaces from production
decisionOptions.performanceResult: Potentially removes MapLibre chunk, but may break OperationalMap or AI compass visuals.
decisionOptions.recommendedWhen: Use this only if those surfaces are not needed in V1 production.
decisionOptions.nextAction: Audit routes/components using OperationalMap and MapHero before removing anything.

recommendedDecision: Choose Option B next: audit whether map chunks are route-only loaded or preloaded too early. Do not consolidate map engines yet inside the bundle optimization lane.

nextPatchRecommendation.label: Map Engine Route Loading Audit
nextPatchRecommendation.goal: Determine whether vendor-mapbox and vendor-maplibre are only loaded on routes that need them, or whether generated HTML/modulepreload behavior is pulling them too early.

doNotDo.label: Do not raise chunkSizeWarningLimit
doNotDo.reason: That hides the warning and does not improve load behavior.

doNotDo.label: Do not rollback Patch 15B or Patch 17
doNotDo.reason: They created a cleaner bundle structure and exposed the true map-engine issue.

doNotDo.label: Do not convert Unified Truth from Mapbox to MapLibre as a quick patch
doNotDo.reason: That is a product/design refactor, not a safe bundle patch.
